summary: hashicorp.terraform.run manages Terraform runs (create, apply, cancel, discard). Requires a valid API token and workspace. Parameters: workspace_id or workspace plus organization, run_id for apply/cancel/discard, tf_token (falls back to TF_TOKEN env). Example creates an auto-applied destroy run targeting two VPCs with polling.
questions: How do I trigger a Terraform run from an Ansible playbook?
Where does hashicorp.terraform.run get the token if tf_token is not set?
How do I create a destroy run with hashicorp.terraform?
